welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Kom ons maak jou gereed vir jou besoek.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Beantwoord 'n paar vrae oor jou simptome.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Dit verbind jou besoek met jou rekord.

interviewLoadError.translation: Ons kon jou onderhoud nie laai nie.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Dankie Ek sal 'n paar vinnige vrae oor jou {complaint} stel. Wanneer het dit begin?

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Dankie Ek sal 'n paar vinnige vrae vra oor wat jou hier gebring het. Wanneer het dit begin?

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Tik 'n antwoord in, of tik op 'n voorstel hierbo

reviewTitle.translation: Hier is wat ek opgemerk het

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Tik op enige item om dit te herstel voordat jy dit stuur.

btnSendToDoctor.translation: Dit lyk reg stuur na die dokter

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: As jou simptome ernstig voel of nou erger word, moenie wag nie bel nooddienste.

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Jou simptome dui op iets wat binnekort gesien moet word.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Die kliniese span ontvang jou gestruktureerde geskiedenis onmiddellik.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: As dit erger word, moet jy vinnig optree

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Ernstige of skielike verswakking skakel nooddienste dadelik.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Dit is 'n outomatiese noodlestelling, nie 'n diagnose nie. 'n Klinikus neem die finale besluit.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Jy is al voorheen in hierdie hospitaal gesien.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Hulle hou al jou rekords, so jou versorging span sien jou volledige geskiedenis dadelik.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Kies 'n Triavi-hospitaal naby jou jou {level} brief word gestuur op die oomblik wat jy kies.

findScanning.translation: Skandering van Triavi hospitale naby jou...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.
findErrLocation.translation: Ons kon jou ligging nie kry nie. Tik die rescan om weer te probeer.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Jou brief is by die versorgingspan, ons sal jou in kennis stel sodra 'n dokter dit oopmaak.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: As dit erger word, tree nou op.

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Moenie wag vir jou ryposisie nie. As jou simptome ernstig is of skielik vererger skakel nou nooddienste of gaan na die naaste nooddiens.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Ons het jou saak as 'n hoër prioriteit gemerk sodat die versorgingspan daarvan bewus is.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: 'n Kliniek is besig om jou brief te hersien, ons sal jou op hoogte hou soos dit vorder.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Beantwoord 'n paar vrae oor hoe jy sedert jou besoek was.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Hoe vergelyk jou toestand met vroeër?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Is daar nog iets wat jy ons wil vertel?

checkinResultResolved.translation: Ons is bly jy voel beter

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Jou antwoorde is aan die versorgingspan gestuur, en 'n klinici sal dit hersien en indien nodig kontak maak.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Jou simptome dui op iets wat dringend aandag nodig het. Moenie wag nie kontak jou versorgingspan of gaan na die naaste nooddiens.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Hierdie opvolg is nie meer beskikbaar nie. Teken in om jou huidige inskrywings te sien.

checkinExpiredSignIn.translation: Teken in om voort te gaan

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Maak 'n gratis rekening om hierdie besoek te volg en skip die kode volgende keer.

authVerifyTitle.translation: Kom ons verifieer dit is jy

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Ons sal 'n eenmalige kode stuur geen wagwoord om te onthou.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Gee jou selfoon of e-pos en ons stuur 'n aanmeldkode.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Jou rekening is gekoppel aan jou hospitaal rekords

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
errSendFailed.translation: Ek kon nie die kode stuur nie.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Netwerkfout, kyk na jou verbinding en probeer weer.

errResendFailed.translation: Ek kon dit nie terugstuur nie, probeer weer.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.
errCodeMismatch.translation: Die kode het nie ooreenstem nie.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Vir jou veiligheid en om pasiëntdata te beskerm, is jy uitgesluit ná 'n tydperk van inaktiwiteit.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Begin 'n inskrywing om 'n nuwe besoek te begin.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Versorgingsoproepe bel in hierdie app · jou telefoonnommer word nooit gedeel nie.

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Kies wie jou bel en hoe dit klink.

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Hallo Jordan, dit is tyd vir jou aand dosis...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Geen oproepe 9:30 pm 7:30 am · val terug na 'n kennisgewing

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Jou versorgingslyn bly aktief Teken weer in om oproepe en herinneringe te bestuur.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Geënkripteerde stemoproep · WebRTC · jou nommer word nooit gedeel nie

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Daar is nog geen sorg nodig vir hierdie besoek nie.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Dit is 'n opsomming wat met jou gedeel word nie 'n diagnose nie. As jou simptome terugkeer of erger word, moet jy onmiddellik noodhulp soek.

visitDetailNotFound.translation: Ons kon die besoek nie vind nie.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Hierdie besoek is dalk verwyder, of die skakel is nie meer geldig nie.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Maak jou besonderhede op datum. Jou dokter sal die nuutste sien.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Verander die taal van elke skerm onmiddellik.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Kon nie kopieer nie - kies en kopieer handmatig

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.
privacySubtitle.translation: Wat ons beskerm, en wat jy beheer.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Jou naam, kontakbesonderhede en antwoorde word uitgeskakel voordat enigiets jou hospitaal verlaat.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Laat onidentifiseerde data toe om die versorging vir almal te verbeter. Jy kan dit te eniger tyd verander.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: U kan dit te eniger tyd verander.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Verwyder permanent jou rekening en kontakbesonderhede. Jou versorgingsgeskiedenis word deur jou hospitaal bewaar soos deur die wet vereis word.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Vra vir 'n eksemplaar van jou besoekopsommings, medikasie en versorgingsgeskiedenis.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Dit verwyder permanent jou rekening en kontakbesonderhede. Jou hospitaal behou jou versorgingsgeskiedenis soos deur die wet vereis. Dit kan nie ongedaan gemaak word nie.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Jou versorgingspan sal binne 72 uur per e-pos bevestig.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Kies 'n formaat en versoek jou uitvoer. Ons sal dit voorberei en stuur 'n veilige skakel na jou geregistreerde e-pos.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Ons stuur binne 24 uur 'n veilige skakel na jou geregistreerde adres.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Geen lêer word hier afgelaai nie - jou rekords word veilig na jou geregistreerde e-pos gestuur.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: Die oproep is afgekeur? geregistreer as geen kontak

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Bel geëindig? aangeteken as geen kontak

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Lê die uitnodigingskakel wat jou hospitaal gestuur het, in, of skandeer hulle QR-kode.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Dit lyk nie soos 'n Triavi-uitnodigingskakel of kode nie.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code
inviteScanSubtitle.translation: Bewys jou kamera na die kode

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: 'n Geldige kliniekkode lei jou reguit na jou besonderhede.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: 'n Geldige kliniek-kode lei jou reguit na jou besonderhede.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Gee kamera toestemming in jou blaaier instellings, of voer die uitnodiging skakel handmatig in.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Gee die uitnodigingskakel wat jou hospitaal gestuur het.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Die kamera is nie beskikbaar nie.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Offline? wys die gestoor onderhoud script
